description_zh: 创建用户级别存储资源
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-drive --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ali-uid 12020000 --user-id user01 --domain-id dom-aaaa0000 --external-domain-id 12340000 --resource-type NAS --type USER_PROFILE --drive-name test01 --description test01 --profile-roaming false --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDrive

parameters.help_en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.name: ali_uid

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the storage resource.

> Call the DescribeDrives operation to retrieve the storage resource ID
parameters.help_zh:
存储资源ID。
> 可通过DescribeDrives接口获取
parameters.name: domain_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the external storage resource.

> Call the DescribeDrives operation to retrieve the external storage resource ID
parameters.help_zh:
外部存储资源ID。
> 可通过DescribeDrives接口获取
parameters.name: external_domain_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the storage resource.

Valid values:

- NAS: File Storage NAS

- PDS: Drive and Photo Service
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The usage of the storage resource.

Valid values:

- DESKTOP: data disk space

- USER\_PROFILE: space for personal data of the user
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The name of the user-level storage resource
parameters.help_zh: 用户级别存储资源名称
parameters.name: drive_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the user-level storage resource
parameters.help_zh: 用户级别存储资源简介
parameters.name: description
